def.brief: Environment refresh, prospective and narrow: AGENTS.md's self-check text changed (c-doc-repairs), so hunsu check reports situations judged about other text of their members. Using only the installed released hunsu 1.15.1 workflow — judge request --stale for exactly the stale situations it lists, the declared judge worker (judge_worker.py) per packet, judge consume, then check/compose/lock — refresh the derived hunsu-judgments.json and, if the engine rewrites it, hunsu.lock.json. No judgment is invented or edited; raw packets, answers and transcripts, and a copy of the bootstrap round's evidence, stay as ignored local evidence in this run's local directory. Resolutions stay reviewed:false unless a human review says otherwise. hostcall.py stays frozen; no plugin version, cache or install changes.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
